periods.description: A northern great nation that sends Krulcifer to the New Kingdom as an exchange student for Drag-Ride learning and international relations.
periods.history: Ymir participates in the broader international order shaped by ruins and Drag-Rides. Its restrictions prevent Krulcifer from taking direct life-threatening combat roles for the New Kingdom.
periods.goals: Acquire Drag-Ride knowledge, maintain diplomatic exchange, and avoid foreign battlefield liability for its student.
periods.structure: Offscreen national authority; Krulcifer acts as a noble exchange student under its instructions.
